# Part 15 plates

**Two sets**, generated by `remotion/scripts/make-plates.mjs` (`npm run plates` —
deterministic, safe to re-run):

- `landscape/` — 14 PNGs at 1920×1080
- `vertical/` — 14 PNGs at 1080×1920

The vertical set is **not** the landscape set cropped. Geometry for both lives in
`scripts/layouts.mjs`, which the same run also compiles into `src/layouts.ts` so the beat
components animate against the numbers the plates were drawn with.

Most plates are full-frame. Two are rendered at natural size for Remotion to place
directly: `coin.png` (96×96) and `shutter.png` (exactly the arched doorway in
`bank-run.png` — 380×380 wide, 440×460 tall). Sizes come from the generator's `sizes` map.

These are **layered**, not flattened stills, because the beat components animate
foreground elements independently of their backgrounds. A single composite image per
beat would not be animatable.

| File | α | Used by | Animated as |
|---|---|---|---|
| `phone-balance.png` | | Beat1Balance | scale 1.00 → 1.06 push-in; phone in the left third, statement only — the figure is an overlay to its right |
| `empty-vault.png` | | Beat3Vault | background + vault ring; camera dollies in |
| `vault-door.png` | ✓ | Beat3Vault | `rotateY` 0 → 90°, `transformOrigin` on the **left** edge (`L.doorHinge`) |
| `lending-cascade.png` | | Beat4Cascade | static backdrop, five glass tiers |
| `coin.png` | ✓ | Beat4Cascade | tiled per-coin, counts `[24,18,13,9,6]` per tier |
| `thirty-owners.png` | | Beat5Owners | 10 × 3 wide / 5 × 6 tall; screens are dark, 30 glow divs stagger on top |
| `owners-coin.png` | ✓ | Beat5Owners | centre coin, stays sharp while the grid blurs |
| `bank-run.png` | | Beat6Run | locked off; light-leak layer cuts to 0 on the slam |
| `shutter.png` | ✓ | Beat6Run | clipped to the arch, `translateY` -height → 0, `Easing.in(Easing.cubic)` |
| `rain-tile.png` | ✓ | Beat6Run | seamless loop, period `L.rainPeriod` (540 wide / 960 tall) |
| `real-assets.png` | | Beat7Assets | full vault; pushed left (wide) or up (tall), slow crane-up |
| `blueprint-house.png` | ✓ | Beat7Assets | drawn centred, placed into `L.blueprints.slots[0]`; `clipPath: inset()` 100% → 0% at beat-local 150 |
| `blueprint-panels.png` | ✓ | Beat7Assets | slot 1, beat-local 195 |
| `blueprint-truck.png` | ✓ | Beat7Assets | slot 2, beat-local 240 |

α = transparent background.

## Notes

- Palette is defined once at the top of the generator: gold `#D4A24C`, teal `#3E8E8C`,
  navy `#0B1A2E`. Keep the HyperFrames overlays on the same three values.
- Geometry lives in `scripts/layouts.mjs` and is compiled to `src/layouts.ts` by the same
  command that draws the plates, so the two cannot drift. Components read it via
  `useLayout()`.
- Scatter (coin pile, rain streaks, crowd) goes through a seeded `mulberry32` PRNG.
  `i * k % n` was tried first and banded into visible diagonal stripes.
- No text is baked into any plate. All figures and type come from the HyperFrames
  overlays, so copy changes never require re-rendering a plate.
- To restyle, edit the generator rather than the PNGs — the layer split and the exact
  pixel geometry the beat components animate against are both encoded there.
